newsitem.title: USA: Dawson sees China venture upping profits.
newsitem.headline: Dawson sees China venture upping profits.

text.p: Dawson Science Corp said on Thursday it expects to add $15 million to its profits each year from a car rental business it plans to set up in China.
The company said it has obtained permits and licenses to set up and operate a car rental business in Guangzhou, China. Dawson said it expects to have a fleet of 1,500 vehicles for rental.

Dawson said studies show that it can expect to bring in about $10,000 profit on each car each year. When the Guangzhou division is fully operation, it expects to add $15 million to its profits annually.
